transactions.desc: The Yankees optioned Schuemann to Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre after Saturday's game against Toronto.
The Angels recalled Campero from Triple-A Salt Lake on Saturday.
The Angels recalled Moore from Triple-A Salt Lake on Saturday.
The Nationals claimed Waldron off waivers from the Blue Jays on Saturday.
The Dodgers recalled Thomas from Triple-A Oklahoma City on Saturday.
The Cardinals recalled Mathews from Triple-A Memphis on Saturday ahead of his start against the Phillies.
The Mariners designated Diaz for assignment Saturday.
The Mariners selected Anderson's contract from Double-A Arkansas ahead of his start Saturday against the Cubs.
The Blue Jays optioned Schneider to Triple-A Buffalo on Saturday.
The Blue Jays reinstated Guerrero (concussion) from the injured list Saturday.
The Marlins recalled De Los Santos from Triple-A Jacksonville on Saturday.
The Marlins optioned Driscoll to Triple-A Jacksonville on Saturday.
The Mariners optioned Davila to Triple-A Tacoma on Friday.
The Mariners reinstated Vargas (lat) from the 60-day injured list Friday.
The Cubs designated Miller for assignment Friday, Taylor McGregor of Marquee Sports Network reports.
The Cubs optioned Assad to Triple-A Iowa on Friday, Taylor McGregor of Marquee Sports Network reports.
The Cubs activated Palencia (elbow) from the 60-day injured list Friday, Taylor McGregor of Marquee Sports Network reports.
The Dodgers recalled Gervase from Triple-A Oklahoma City on Friday.
The Dodgers optioned Sheehan to Triple-A Oklahoma City on Friday.
The Cardinals recalled Fernandez from Triple-A Memphis on Friday, Derrick Goold of the St. Louis Post-Dispatch reports.
The Royals optioned Duran to Triple-A Omaha on Friday.
The Royals recalled Cuas from Triple-A Omaha on Friday.
The Royals recalled Lugo from Triple-A Omaha on Friday.
The Blue Jays optioned Cellucci to Triple-A Buffalo on Friday.
The Blue Jays recalled Schneider from Triple-A Buffalo on Friday.
The Rockies optioned Amador to Triple-A Albuquerque on Friday.
The Blue Jays activated Arrighetti (foot) from the 15-day injured list Friday.
The Rockies activated Karros from the 7-day injured list Friday.
The Astros optioned King to Triple-A Sugar Land on Friday, Chandler Rome of The Athletic reports.
The Astros recalled Teng from Triple-A Sugar Land on Friday, Chandler Rome of The Athletic reports.
